Messages.Author: umur...@cc.umanitoba.ca
Messages.Body:
If you play 2 long term investments, instead of taking a
master phase action, can you draw from one or both at the same time?
This is assuming you only have one master phase action per round, and
of course assuming that you played the longs on different turns.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. You use a master phase action *to* take a counter off (you don't
take a counter *instead of* taking an MPA).

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3ac368f9...@news.cc.umanitoba.ca>,
umur...@cc.umanitoba.ca writes

> If you play 2 long term investments, instead of taking a
>master phase action, can you draw from one or both at the same time?

You must spend one master phase action to use one, and another, separate
master phase action to use the other.

In a "normal" master phase, you only have one so can only use one. If
you have, say, the Parthenon, you could use both of them (or two off
one) in a single master phase.
